title: Alchemy
description: Infrastructure as Effects (Alchemy v2): infra/alchemy.run.ts declares the Worker and its bindings instead of wrangler.jsonc, with PR preview stages deployed from GitHub Actions.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Needed by `pnpm run deploy` (with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, or a login from `pnpm exec alchemy login`).

guide.purpose: Declares the Worker and its bindings in TypeScript, in `infra/alchemy.run.ts`, instead of `wrangler.jsonc`, which it removes. `pnpm dev` and `pnpm run deploy` go through Alchemy, and `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` deploys a preview stage for each pull request.
limits: Local secrets are read from `.env`, not `.dev.vars`.
On D1, `pnpm db:migrate` still expects a `wrangler.jsonc`.
